node.body:
# Dominant Strategy Profile is a Nash Equilibrium

If every player $i$ plays a weakly dominant strategy $s_i$, then the resulting
profile $\sigma = (s_i)_{i \in I}$ is a Nash equilibrium.

*Proof.* A weakly dominant strategy weakly dominates every alternative. In particular,
for any player $i$ and any deviation $s'_i$, we have
$u_i(\sigma[i \mapsto s'_i]) \le u_i(\sigma)$. This means each player is best
responding, so $\sigma$ is a Nash equilibrium. $\square$
node.title: Dominant Strategy Profile is a Nash Equilibrium

theorems.body:
def IsNashEquilibrium (G : StrategicGame N U) (σ : G.Profile) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : N, IsBestResponse G σ i

namespace IsNashEquilibrium

/-- T3: If every player has a weakly dominant strategy and `σ` assigns each player
    their dominant strategy, then `σ` is a Nash equilibrium. -/
theorems.name: IsNashEquilibrium

theorems.body:
theorem of_dominant {G : StrategicGame N U} {σ : G.Profile}
    (h : ∀ i : N, IsWeaklyDominant G i (σ i)) : IsNashEquilibrium G σ :=
  fun i => (h i).isBestResponse σ rfl

end IsNashEquilibrium
